---
id: arctic-tern
title: Arctic tern
---
The Arctic tern (*Sterna paradisaea*) nests on Arctic and subarctic
coasts, then follows ocean productivity toward Antarctic pack ice for the
opposite months, tracing a loop that can exceed the circumference of the
Earth in one circuit. Long, pointed wings and a streamer tail mark the
bird in flight. It takes fish by plunge-diving.
